newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador minister confident on upcoming Euro issue.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador minister confident on upcoming Euro issue.

text.p: Ecuador's Finance Minister Carlos Davalos said Thursday he was confident the country's first-ever Eurobond issue on April 14 will be a success.

"The result will be known on the day that the orders will be made. However, the information we have from the lead managers and the central bank gives the impression that there is big interest," Davalos told Reuters.
Davalos added that the planned amount of $300 million could be raised to $400 million if there is sufficient demand. Chase Manhattan Corp is lead managing the issue.
Ecuadorean government officials will travel to Europe and the United States this weekend to promote the bonds.
The process of launching Ecuador's first Eurobond was first begun under former President Abdala Bucaram. His ouster by Congress in February led to a delay of the issue.

Initial speculation was that the bond would have a five-year maturity and that it would be priced around 350 basis points over similar dated U.S. Treasuries. Officials have not confirmed that those will be the terms now.
